title: AI Code Reviews: Failure Modes
summary: AI agents fail in novel ways (invented APIs, stray imports, hard-coded values). Reliable review must look beyond the diff and rank issues by impact.

title: Securing AI Agents in Cloud-Native Infrastructure
summary: Companies are increasingly running untrusted code on behalf of users via AI agents that clone repos, analyze bugs, write fixes, and open PRs.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM)
summary: Open-source CLI by Microsoft/GitHub engineers to manage agent dependencies (plugins, skills, rules, hooks, MCP) with a lock file (apm.lock) for Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor. Includes 'apm audit' for supply-chain attacks.

title: G0 - Control Layer for AI Agents
summary: A security tool for AI agents that performs static/behavioral analysis, red teaming, and runtime monitoring. Specifically supports OpenClaw gateway hardening and skill analysis.

title: Security Registry for AI Agent Skills
summary: Highlights supply-chain attacks via unsigned skill.md files. Demonstrated malicious payloads in Claude Code and Codex that exfiltrate env vars and git config.

title: AI Agents for Infra Deployment
summary: Specialized agents to deploy and manage cloud infrastructure (K8s, AWS, GCP) that retain context across sessions.
